notes: Registration input, not a run input: 1-minute candles of the two BTC hourly series (KXBTC range, KXBTCD above/below) from the kalshi_history pack (ADR-0236), period_interval 1 and candle_grouping 'event': every strike of an event in ONE request chain (about 190 strikes), following the venue's adjusted_end_ts, instead of one request per market. THE COST: only LIVE markets are grouped by event. An ARCHIVED market (settled before the cutoff) is always requested alone from /historical/markets/{ticker}/candlesticks, and the pack has no date bound, so the first pull costs one request per archived market plus about three per live event. COUNT the archived hourly markets in the markets snapshot first (runbook section 7) and do not start this pull until that cost is accepted. statuses are the pack default [settled, closed, open] on purpose: 'closed' lists a market between its close and its settlement, without which the candle cursor can skip it for good (the pack documents this); an open market contributes only complete minutes (a candle that ends after the capture is dropped). One source per asset because a failed pull commits nothing; the other asset's half is source-kalshi-history-candles-hourly-eth.json (tests/test_configs.py pins the two against the four hourly series). Candle ts is the END of the minute in epoch SECONDS (Binance columns are ms); the columns are the kalshi pack's candles (open, high, low, close, mean, yes_bid_close, yes_ask_close, volume, open_interest), so crypto_trading.kalshi_rows:CandleRows reads them unchanged. A minute with no trade has null prices; the bid and ask columns still hold the book. Never use a candle that ends after the market's close as a feature (post-settlement prices are about 0 or 1). Register: python -m dskit.onboarding register-source kalshi-history-candles-hourly-btc --catalog-source kalshi-history-candles-hourly-btc --connector dskit.onboarding.libs.kalshi_history:KalshiHistoryConnector --config @configs/source-kalshi-history-candles-hourly-btc.json --activate --root <store root>; then acquire --source kalshi-history-candles-hourly-btc --stream candles --mode backfill; validate with configs/suite-kalshi-history-candles.json.
